assembly_allowance.applies_to: Final-tree cap is the input totals plus this allowance.
assembly_allowance.replacement_record_note: Conservative carry-forward: retained the prior reviewed aggregate RECORD allowance, including the replaced vendor wheel, and added the complete measured own-wheel allowance. The retained surplus is not a new measurement.

measurement.input_bounds: Measured entries are exact unpruned regular-member totals, including every regular wheel ZIP member and dereferenced runtime links. Conservative entries are unmeasured enforced limits: max(16 MiB, compressed bytes * 16), and 8,192 regular files. An unseen wheel may exceed the cap and must then fail closed.

measurement_provenance.new_input: Published own CPU wheel: size/SHA-256 checked and all regular ZIP members measured without execution.
measurement_provenance.unchanged_inputs: Inherited exact archive measurements from the reviewed prior caps; unchanged runtime and 21 wheel identities were cross-checked against shipping locks, not remeasured in this activation workspace.

measurement.method: size-and-sha256-verified archives; no installation or execution
measurement.output_bounds: Caps, not measured installed usage. All-measured packs add complete replacement RECORD allowances, 64 KiB/eight metadata files per wheel, and 2 MiB/256 fixed assembly files. Packs with any unmeasured input instead have an independent 4 GiB/100,000-file final-tree ceiling. Final output must be checked against its cap; per-input file caps are not a prediction that all inputs reach those maxima.
